A regulatory site ( also known as an `` allosteric site '' ) is a site on an allosteric protein to which a modulator molecule ( or allosteric regulator ) binds .
This ligand - binding site on a receptor or enzyme is distinct from the active site .
Allosteric modulators alter enzyme activity by binding to the regulatory site .
Some allosteric regulators activate enzymes , while others inhibit them .
